title: Invariant-Preserving Decomposition of Submodular-Like Graph Widths in Kotlin
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We investigate the separation of submodular-like width measures in undirected weighted graphs by leveraging a deterministic cut-based decomposition that preserves optimal substructure. The proposed Kotlin implementation extends the Stoer-Wagner minimum-cut routine to expose intermediate partition invariants that enable incremental width estimation. We prove that the algorithm maintains an acyclic contraction DAG and that each contraction step reduces the global width by at least the weight of the selected minimum cut, yielding a worst-case time complexity of $O(|V|^{3})$ and space complexity $O(|V|^{2})$. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/kotlin-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261115_140130_separations_between_submodular}.
